title: Beaver chomping on a log (3.33m)
author: Mobius_Play109
changes: A beaver gnawing (chomping) on a log; a run of repeated bites into the wood (the Freesound page does not name the species). Trimmed to 101.40–104.30 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 250 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The high-pass removes measured low-frequency background noise below about 300 Hz.
